result.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response object when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT are set ('return response;' from the fetch call). In hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts the result is typed as HubspotToken and used directly, so in sync mode expiresIn would be undefined, expiryDate becomes NaN, and the Response object would be stored as the credential key — exactly as the finding describes. Verifiable mechanism from the diff.
